label: 📐 Two-sample t-test
description: Welch's two-sample independent t-test. Compares the mean of `value` between the two groups in `group`, returns t, p-value, df, per-group means + sample sizes. Assumes the value column is roughly normal within each group; use ks_test if you can't assume that.

group.label: Group column (binary)
group.help: Categorical column with exactly two distinct non-null values.

alternative.label: Alternative hypothesis
alternative.help: two-sided = means differ; less = group A < group B; greater = group A > group B (alphabetical order).

equal_var.label: Assume equal variance
equal_var.help: Off (default) = Welch's t (recommended). On = classical Student's t — only correct when both groups have similar variance.
